name: Hydraulic fracturing (plug-and-perf, electric frac fleets)
principle: High-pressure fluid and proppant open fractures along a cased and perforated lateral in stages; plug-and-perf isolates each stage with a plug, while sliding sleeves open one at a time. Typical fluid is about 90% water, 9.5% sand and 0.5% additives, and pumps reach 100 MPa (15,000 psi).

process_steps.name: Set plug to isolate stage and repeat

key_equipment: frac pumps (diesel, dual fuel or electric)

performance.basis: up to 5 million for large projects

source.note: Wikipedia, Hydraulic fracturing, read 25 October 2026 (secondary source)

performance.basis: 30% on reciprocating-engine power, up to 45% on ERCOT grid; Halliburton estimate

advantages: Electric fleets displace diesel (Halliburton cites 900,000 gal/month in one simul-frac example)
limitations: Wikipedia notes elevated shares of fracks using chemicals the Safe Drinking Water Act recognises as harmful
